eval.description: Anthropic agentic bioinformatics benchmark: anonymized real datasets with objective answers that need analysis tools and code, not dataset lookup. Graded on the final answer against a rubric. Cards split Human Solvable (or Verified) vs Human Difficult (or Hard). The gated full set on Hugging Face has 90 problems after a 2026-07 audit (the research post described 99: 76 human-solvable and 23 human-difficult).
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents solve real bioinformatics problems by analyzing data with code and tools.

links.title: Evaluating Claude’s bioinformatics research capabilities with BioMysteryBench

versions.changes: v11 audit on Hugging Face: 9 problems removed and others edited; full set lists 90 problems.

sampleTerms.quote: BioMysteryBench is provided for **evaluation and benchmarking only**. By requesting access you agree that you will not use this benchmark (problem statements, answer rubrics, task formulation) to train, fine-tune, reinforce, or distill any machine-learning model. You may use it to construct evaluation prompts at inference time and to publish benchmark results with attribution to Anthropic.

scores.description: The agent's final answer matches the problem rubric.

metrics.description: Share of problems solved. Cards often report Human Solvable and Human Difficult separately.
